expectations.text: States that since June 2026 LinkedIn Lives cannot be started spontaneously and must be scheduled as an event
expectations.evidence: Since 22 June 2026 every LinkedIn Live is a scheduled event.

expectations.text: States that at stream start notifications go to event attendees, not to all page followers
expectations.evidence: event attendees are notified, plus only a subset of likely-viewing followers, not all 9,000

expectations.text: Recommends creating the LinkedIn event as soon as possible and inviting connections, noting LinkedIn advises about two weeks of lead time
expectations.evidence: Create the event today. Invite connections... You have 5 days, not the 2 weeks LinkedIn advises

expectations.text: States that links posted in LinkedIn Live comments are not clickable
expectations.evidence: Links in live comments render as plain text [platform]

expectations.text: States that LinkedIn's live guidelines discourage selling or promotional streams, and moves the discount pitch out of the stream or tones it down
expectations.evidence: Put the code in the launch post and the recap post... Don't mention the code on air.

expectations.text: Notes that a broadcast tool or RTMP encoder is needed because LinkedIn has no in-app camera for Live
expectations.evidence: LinkedIn has no in-app camera [platform], so use a partner tool or a custom RTMP stream.

expectations.text: Notes LinkedIn Live eligibility criteria (more than 150 followers, account or Page at least 30 days old) or confirms the page meets them
expectations.evidence: 150+ followers and 30+ days old, which you should meet at 9,000 followers.

expectations.text: Builds the run-of-show around viewer questions (for example collected in advance) rather than a feature walkthrough only
expectations.evidence: Chat's role is asking what the docs missed; questions collected in launch post replies; Q&A segment; teaser asks for questions.

expectations.text: Assigns a moderator separate from the VP Engineering
expectations.evidence: Moderator (separate device, chat only) distinct from Host VP Eng.

expectations.text: Keeps any starting screen short (one to two minutes at most)
expectations.evidence: Starting screen under 1–2 minutes [platform].

expectations.text: Includes a recap or repurposing step after the stream (replay, clips)
expectations.evidence: Export the recording, add chapters, and cut 2–4 clips; Recap post.
